description: A class describes a kind of object; calling it, as in `Counter(10)`, creates an instance with its own data.
`__init__` sets the starting attributes of a new instance; every method receives the instance it was called on as `self`.
A name assigned in the class body, shared by every instance; per-object data belongs on `self` in `__init__`.
Returns the text that describes an object in `print`, `repr` and the debugger, ideally written like the call that creates it.
`class Timer(Counter):` gets every method of `Counter` and may override them; `super().__init__(...)` runs the parent's setup.
